key_entities: git_adapter mutation primitives: add, commit, commit_tree, read_tree, rm_cached, update_ref, write_tree
propositions: The existing raw-git-writes gate (R1/R2) enforces no-raw-subprocess rule but misses non-atomic git-adapter primitive compositions outside the locked seam, because sanctions are applied module-wide to exports rather than scoped to transaction entry points.

R3 (seam-composition rule) must fire when mutation primitives (add, commit, commit_tree, read_tree, rm_cached, update_ref, write_tree) are called from outside sanctioned seam files (git_adapter.py, _ref_lock.py, _ref_lock_push.py, _pass_lock_lifecycle.py), detected via import/dynamic-loader receiver bindings.

Two durable reasoned inline # raw-git-ok: markers are required on out-of-transaction composition sites: reconcile_helpers.py:226/246 (selective 5-file staging boundary preventing seam routing) and __main__.py:338-351 (_purge_committed_reconciler_locks detached-index CAS migration).

Bare-name .add()/.commit() calls and non-git-adapter reads (commit_email) must not fire false positives; receiver binding resolves only git-adapter module references via import names or dynamic-loader paths.

The module-size gate violation from adding the marker to __main__.py:338-351 is resolved by extracting _pass_lock_lifecycle.py (pass-lock lifecycle, _lock_steal_enabled, _resolve_held_lock, _acquire_or_adopt_pass_lock, _purge_committed_reconciler_locks, _LEGACY_LOCK_FILES), reducing __main__.py from 804 to 704 LOC.
Landing is sequenced after blocker tickets 6454-d06e and fea4-f98c close; first R3 run enumerates exactly the two reasoned sites with zero false positives or debt baseline.
